articles.title: Apex Client Beta 1.0.2 Released!
articles.content: Version 1.0.2 fixes the Microsoft authentication issue! Login now works properly. This update also adds Prism Launcher attribution to the login dialog, showing that authentication is provided through Prism Launcher's secure OAuth system.

articles.title: Apex Client Beta 1.0.0 Released!
articles.content: Welcome to the first beta release of Apex Client! This custom Minecraft launcher includes automatic mod installation for Minecraft 1.21.11 with Fabric loader. Features include user detection to see other Apex Client users in-game.
